validation.quality_protocol: Native BF16 reference and tail-four sessions; candidate decode is teacher-forced with BF16 reference tokens; every prompt independently requires mean KL <=0.05 and top-1 >=90%.

performance.protocol: Production WMMA bulk prefill and GEMV graph decode; repeated rows use one discarded eager warmup and three fresh state-bound measured graph runs per layout; graph capture excluded.

memory_128k.transient_attribution: Inferred: the transient is byte-exact to four BF16 full-attention K/V layer caches (4 * 268,959,744 bytes). It is freed before decode and is not a persistent shadow, but prevents allocator-high-water savings.
